name: CSIR-UGC NET Junior Research Fellowship (CSIR-JRF)
funder: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Government of India (exam by NTA)
amount: Rs 37,000/month JRF (2 years), then SRF rate; Rs 20,000/year contingency from year 3
other_rules: Master's degree with at least 55% (50% SC/ST/PwD)
JRF age limit under 30 (relaxation 5 years SC/ST/PwD/women, 3 years OBC)
qualify in the national exam (held twice a year)
notes: Dates shown are from the December 2025 session (applications 25 Sep to 27 Oct 2025, exam 18 Dec 2025); check NTA for the next session. Fellowship is taken up on PhD registration.
